name: Autonoe of Koranthia
source:
Autonoe of Koranthia is an old friend of Utsushikome's grandfather. She is the one who leaks the fact Samium of Ur-Ysar will be at the Sanctuary of Apsu to her.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Autonoe_of_Koranthia]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
